error: Resource class "my-org/new-runner" was created, but generating its token failed.
The API token was rejected by CircleCI.

Suggestions:
  • Create the token separately: circleci runner token create my-org/new-runner --nickname default
  • Run: circleci auth login
  • Or set the CIRCLE_TOKEN environment variable
  • See: circleci help getting-started

Reference: https://app.circleci.com/settings/user/oauth-clients
